about.title: A bridge between Italian manufacturers and major international projects.
paragraphs: Opera Trade is built on Damiano Baldoni’s long experience in the international furniture trade. We work only with companies that have been producing successfully for decades, in Italy and abroad, and put them at the service of those who build and furnish beyond Italy.
Every request is a tailored search: the right manufacturer, the unique product, the competitive price. Then we stay at our client’s side until delivery.

pillars.title: Rigorous selection
pillars.text: Only manufacturers with decades of history and proven quality.

pillars.title: Tailored sourcing
pillars.text: The right product for the project, not the easiest one to sell.

pillars.title: On-site presence
pillars.text: An office in Baku to follow clients, deliveries and sites up close.
